title: SEC3: Duplicated fetch logic in test vs. production code
description:
fetch_with_https_client (lines 393-469) and fetch_peer_blob_from_url test helper (lines 511-570) duplicate nearly identical code:

- Content-Length header parsing (429-441 vs 541-549)
- Body collection and size check (445-466 vs 552-567)

Only difference: production uses HTTPS client, test uses plain HTTP.

Refactor: Extract common logic into a parameterized inner function that accepts client as argument. Eliminates ~70 LOC duplication while keeping both code paths.
